items.reasoning: The application violates two independent FHA manual-underwriting requirements with no available cure. (1) The requested LTV is 98.2% ($280,000 loan on a $285,000 appraised value), which exceeds the maximum purchase LTV of 96.5% of Adjusted Value permitted under HUD 4000.1 II.A.2.b. (2) The calculated qualifying ratios are 47.2% front-end (PTI) and 58.9% back-end (DTI), which exceed even the highest manual-underwriting stretch tier of 40/50 available under HUD 4000.1 II.A.5.d viii for Borrowers with a Minimum Decision Credit Score of 580 or above with two documented compensating factors. Because the ratios exceed the maximum permissible tier outright, no combination of compensating factors (cash reserves, minimal payment increase, residual income, or additional income) can cure this deficiency per HUD 4000.1 II.A.5.d ix. The credit score of 618 is itself above the 580 minimum decision threshold and would otherwise support maximum financing, but the LTV and DTI violations are independently disqualifying.
